agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements, granting full discharge of liability to the Board of Directors and Commissioners. The financial reports received unqualified opinions from auditors Purwanto, Susanti, and Surja.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the allocation of USD 215,364,799 in net profit, distributing 80% as cash dividends and 20% as retained earnings. The Board of Directors is authorized to manage the dividend schedule, currency conversion, and tax deductions.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to the Majority Series B Shareholder and the Board of Commissioners to set salaries, honorariums, facilities, and performance remuneration for the Board of Directors and Commissioners for FY 2025 and 2026.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners was authorized, with prior approval from the Majority Series B Shareholder, to appoint a Public Accounting Firm for the 2026 financial audits and determine service fees.
Agenda #5: The meeting delegated authority to the Board of Commissioners to approve the 2027 Annual Work Plan and Budget (RKAP) and its amendments. This process requires approval from the Majority Series B Shareholder and coordination with the Series A Dwiwarna Shareholder.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved amendments to Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align the company's purpose and business activities with 2025 KBLI regulations. The Board of Directors was granted authority to execute all necessary legal and administrative actions related to these changes.
Agenda #7: The meeting approved the addition of "Industri Gas Industri" (KBLI 20112) to the business activities of subsidiary PT Pertamina Gas to comply with OJK regulations. This involves an amendment to Article 3 of PT Pertamina Gas's Articles of Association.
Agenda #8: Shareholders approved a special assignment for the company to manage the State Budget-funded (APBN) Natural Gas Network. The assignment includes provisions for cost reimbursement and a reasonable profit margin.
Agenda #9: This agenda item regarding the change in the composition of the company's management was cancelled, and no resolution was adopted.
